description: One-call, token-budgeted briefing on a symbol: definition source, surrounding file outline, type context, top callers/callees, route (if a handler), and related tests — instead of stitching six separate lookups. Sections that exceed the budget are named so you can ask for them specifically. Optional task string pulls in possibly relevant symbols.

max_tokens.description: soft cap on response size in estimated tokens

path.description: with line: innermost symbol at that position

task.description: what you are about to do, in plain language — biases which sections matter
